title: Decoding the transverse encoding
statement: For every set $A$ with decidable equality and every possibly blank symbol $a\in A\cup\{\bot\}$, decoding the transverse encoding of $a$ returns $a$, including when $a$ is blank.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a possibly blank symbol over $A$
replaced:
For every possibly-blank symbol $a$ over an alphabet $A$ with decidable equality,
decoding the transverse encoding of $a$ returns $a$; this includes the blank block.
